_comment: Every schema conditional (allOf entry with if/then) discovered by conformance_tests.py MUST have an entry here, or the suite fails with UNCOVERED CONDITIONAL and exit code 1 (V31-03). Each entry names one positive case and one negative case that must exist among CASES in conformance_tests.py and must have should_pass True / False respectively.

cost-event.schema.json.negative_case: negative amount for a non-adjustment kind

publication.schema.json.negative_case: VERIFIED with required label not applied

referral.schema.json.positive_case: ACTIVE via official API with evidence
